news.title:
Equitas Small Finance Bank's Q4 FY26 profit surged 406% YoY to Rs 213 crore; NII rose 18% YoY to Rs 981 crore.
NIM improved to 7.29%; GNPA reduced to 2.49%; advances grew 22% YoY; RoA increased to 1.46%, RoE to 14.1%.
news.summary:
Equitas Small Finance Bank's Q4 FY26 profit surged 406% YoY to Rs 213 crore; NII rose 18% YoY to Rs 981 crore.
NIM improved to 7.29%; GNPA reduced to 2.49%; advances grew 22% YoY; RoA increased to 1.46%, RoE to 14.1%.
